question.text: What will Samolet's BO-P16 bond close at on 13 November 2026, as a percentage of par?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the Moscow Exchange closing price of ПАО «ГК «Самолет» exchange-traded bonds series БО-П16 (ISIN RU000A10BFX7) on the main bond board (TQCB) on 13 November 2026, expressed in percent of nominal value (par). The value is the CLOSE field for TRADEDATE 2026-11-13 in the Moscow Exchange ISS history data: https://iss.moex.com/iss/history/engines/stock/markets/bonds/boards/TQCB/securities/RU000A10BFX7.json?from=2026-11-13&till=2026-11-13 (for example, a CLOSE value of 60.05 means the question resolves to 60.05). If the bond does not trade on 13 November 2026 (including because of a trading halt or suspension), the CLOSE value from the most recent trading day before that date on the same board is used.

research:
I couldn't confirm any news dated 2 November, so the latest event-driven move I found is the 30 October drop.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-30: The MOEX ISS history for TQCB shows the latest final CLOSE at **60.05** (low 57, high 66.5, 1,899 trades, YIELDCLOSE 98.75%). [MOEX ISS](https://iss.moex.com/iss/history/engines/stock/markets/bonds/boards/TQCB/securities/RU000A10BFX7.json?from=2026-10-01&till=2026-11-02)
- 2026-11-02: Live market data at 21:17 Moscow time, with the session still trading: LAST **60.2**, open 60.21, low 59, high 61.58, 1,295 trades, yield 98.45%, PREVPRICE 60.05, NEXTCOUPON 2026-11-13, accrued interest RUB 13.97. The bond is on listing level 3. Today's figure is not final yet. [MOEX ISS marketdata](https://iss.moex.com/iss/engines/stock/markets/bonds/boards/TQCB/securities/RU000A10BFX7.json?iss.meta=off)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The price has held at about 60, the level it reached after the 30 October drop.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-30: VTB first deputy chairman Dmitry Pyanov said Samolet could be the first big case of a "comprehensive sanation agreement" under the new bankruptcy law. The aim would be comfortable terms and periods for restructuring existing debt. He said converting the debt into shares is unlikely. Within about an hour BO-P16 fell to 575.7 rubles (about 57.6% of par), a yield of about 104.9%. BO-P11 fell to 589.9 rubles, and losses across issues reached 13-14%. [Vedomosti](https://www.vedomosti.ru/investments/news/2026/10/30/1241577-obligatsii-samoleta), [Expert](https://expert.ru/news/vtb-dopustil-primenenie-novogo-mekhanizma-sanatsii-k-developeru-samolet), [Fontanka](https://www.fontanka.ru/2026/10/30/76734342/), [finance.mail.ru](https://finance.mail.ru/article/obligatsii-samoleta-snizilis-na-fone-novostej-o-vozmozhnoj-sanatsii-69234986/)
- 2026-10-30/31: How this might work, according to analysts and smart-lab bloggers:
  - Bondholders could face maturity extensions, lower coupons or exchanges into new bonds.
  - Such an agreement needs backing from more than 50% of independent creditors and approval by an arbitration court, after which it binds everyone.
  - It is unclear whether the bonds would be included.
  - Article 31.1 reportedly takes effect only on 27 July 2027.
  - Normal bond restructuring needs 75% of holders. Under the new procedure bondholders would be a minority by claim size.

  These are secondary, partly forum-based sources. - 2026-09-28/29: Technical default on BO-P20. Only RUB 269 per RUB 1,000 of par was paid on the redemption date, and bonds fell up to 40%. - MOEX bond prices are quoted clean (without accrued interest), so the coupon by itself should not mechanically lower the price. This is my understanding of MOEX convention, not something I verified in these sources.

## 5. Other forecasts
- None of the prediction markets supplied (Kalshi, Polymarket) relate to Samolet. I found no Manifold or Metaculus market and no published analyst price target for BO-P16.

## 6. Upcoming events before 13 November
- 2026-11-04: Russian public holiday (National Unity Day). MOEX is normally closed; I did not check the 2026 calendar.
- Ongoing: the bank recovery programme is being finalised. Any statement on whether bonds are included, or on haircuts or extensions, is the main risk either way.
- Other Samolet bond coupons or redemptions in 3-12 November: I could not confirm which ones fall in this window. A late payment on any series would probably weigh on BO-P16.
- 2026-11-13: the BO-P16 coupon of RUB 20.96 per bond (about RUB 63 m in total) is due on the resolution day. [smart-lab](https://smart-lab.ru/q/bonds/RU000A10BFX7/), [investfunds](https://investfunds.ru/bonds/1835785/), [Finam](https://bonds.finam.ru/issue/details040A000002/default.asp)
- Further rating actions from ACRA or Expert RA, and Samolet disclosures on e-disclosure.ru, are possible. Nothing scheduled turned up.

  - Progress on the bills that would bring 253-FZ forward to 1 Jan 2027.
  - Any rating actions or statements from Samolet itself. I found no direct statement from Samolet in the recent coverage.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** about 11 calendar days, roughly 8 to 9 trading sessions (3, 5, 6 and 9 to 13 November). 4 November is likely a holiday. The coupon on 13 November falls on the resolution day itself.

(b) **Latest value:** the last final CLOSE was 60.05 on 30 October 2026. On 2 November the bond was trading at about 60.2 intraday, in a range of 59 to 61.6.

(c) **If nothing changed:** about 60.

(d) **If the trend continued:** October drifted down by about 7 points over the month. Extending that gives about 57 to 58 by 13 November.

(e) **Historical variation:** over 9 trading days the bond has moved between -4 and +10 points. Single news days move it by ±4 to 7 points. A reasonable standard deviation for this horizon is about 8 to 9 points, with a fatter left tail.

(f) **Expert and market views:** there is no forecast market and no analyst price target. The market is pricing a meaningful chance of a haircut or maturity extension, at a yield near 99%. October payments were all made on time, which supports a high probability that the 13 November coupon is paid, perhaps 85 to 90%.

(g) **Scenarios:**
- *Low:* the banks' sanation plan explicitly includes bonds with a haircut or long extension, or the 13 November coupon or another series' payment is late. The price could then fall to the 35 to 45 range.
- *High:* the plan is finalised with state or bank liquidity, bonds are excluded from restructuring, and the coupon is paid. The price could then rebound to the 70s or low 80s.
